items.summary: Add backend enforcement so that, for the single-comment generator flow only, the same device can generate at most one comment per comment list; subsequent attempts for the same (device, listName) must fail with a clear error.

Update the Customer View single comment generator UI to implement 'one comment per list per device' by generating/persisting a device identifier in browser local storage, using it when calling the backend single-comment API, and disabling the single-generate button (or showing an English error) when the device has already generated a single comment for the selected list.

If the backend uses stable persisted state for comment generator data, add/extend the migration to initialize any new persisted structure needed to track per-(device, listName) single-generation usage without breaking existing deployments.
